question: Which of the following is the biggest Biosphere Reserve of India in terms of geographical area?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kachchh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Kachchh Biosphere Reserve** is the largest biosphere reserve in India in terms of geographical area.
 
• It is located in the state of Gujarat and covers a vast area, including coastal areas, wetlands, and salt marshes.
 
• **Covering an extensive area of 12,454 square kilometers**, it became a biosphere reserve in 2008.
 
• The **region hosts the renowned Rann Utsav, **a vibrant celebration of culture, showcasing the traditional crafts and music of the local communities.
 
• The** biosphere reserve is a haven for wildlife enthusiasts, offering glimpses of the endangered Indian Wild Ass and serving as a crucial habitat for various migratory birds.**
